caption: The drawing is on a beige or lightly yellowed paper background with three small illustrations positioned in the center of the page. The top illustration depicts a gold-colored band or ring with a round, silver or gray setting in the center, containing a gemstone or decorative element. Below this, there are two outline sketches in pencil, displaying the object from side and top views. The left pencil sketch shows a side profile of the band or ring, and the right pencil sketch shows a top view with a circular center detail visible, similar to the element shown in the top colored illustration. The overall composition places these three drawings close together near the center, with ample blank space surrounding them.
title: Tie Pin
